_meta.name: compose-sem-invariance-ladder
_meta.description: The measurement-invariance ladder as ONE compose sweep: a zip over two axes, step [configural, metric, scalar] and eq ["", "loadings", "loadings,intercepts"], expands one multi-group MAT_SEM request (the two-factor CFA of survey.pulse across the panel waves) into three slots labelled by step. group_equal reads the eq value as one comma-separated string ("" = configural, nothing held equal), so a scalar sweep axis can carry it. Each slot is a joint lavaan fit; dof rises step by step as loadings, then intercepts, are held equal across waves. Compare chi2, dof, cfi and rmsea slot to slot: a small chi2 rise per degree of freedom gained supports the stricter step. Pulse computes no chi-square difference test. The scalar slot frees the latent means of wave b (marker units; wave a stays 0).
